contexts.text: Its tongs and its snuff-dishes () = things purificatory and evacuatory in the Natural. (Explained.)
On those who appear like iron fire tongs.
A fork = the knowledge of sensuous things... E. B. had such a fork... [NCBS: Swedenborg uses the Swedish word gaffel here, for fork. E. B. is probably Erik Benzelius.]
One appeared above with a knife and scissors. [NCBS: Swedenborg uses Swedish here: knif och sax.] Explained. DMin 4575.
He fabricates the iron with the tongs () = the falsity which he calls truth. ( = to hatch falsities. AE 587:7.)
